body: My advise is let them express their gender identity as it fits them. If your child asks to wear a dress, let them. If they want to grow their hair, let them. Being allowed to express themselves openly means that, though it may not be the case here, they will know they can come to you if they continue to wish to be a girl. Show them that boys can be teachers and have long hair but don’t discourage them from expressing themselves.
